UPSSSC UP Pollution Control Board Various Post Final Answer Key 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the final answer key for the posts of Scientific Assistant, Scientific Assistant (Special Selection), Accountant/Auditor, Law Assistant, Laboratory Assistant, Monitoring Assistant, Junior Engineer (Special Selection), and Junior Engineer in UP Pollution Control Board Recruitment 2026 on the official website of UPSSSC. Applications for the UPSSSC UP Pollution Control Board Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 02 April 2026, to 29 April 2026. The written examination was conducted on 29 June 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this examination can download their UPSSSC UP Pollution Control Board Various Post Final Answer Key 2026 from the link given below..
